name: Hitokazoe
source:
There's a ghost who counts people.
If you manage to run away before it's done counting, you'll be safe.
But if you don't...

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/2764]Freem![/url]]
translation:
有鬼数人。
如果你能在计数完成之前逃走，你就会安全。
但如果你不…
